methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page where the page returned readable content. Monarch Money's pricing page (monarch.com/pricing) renders via JavaScript and returned only partial content; Core plan pricing ($99.99/yr, $14.99/mo) was confirmed via NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026) and an independent review (wellkeptwallet.com, April 2026). The Plus plan ($199/yr, annual only) was confirmed via the official Monarch announcement page (monarch.com/blog/monarch-plus) and added. Rocket Money does not publish a single fixed price for its Premium tier; the official pricing explainer states a 'pay-what-you-want' range of $7–$14/mo with a $7/mo minimum, which is recorded as monthlyUsd (a prior $3/mo figure could not be confirmed and was corrected). Quicken Simplifi's official pricing comparison page (quicken.com/products/pricing-comparison) shows a promotional first-year rate of $2.99/mo and a regular annual rate of $5.99/mo billed annually; the regular rate is recorded as monthlyUsd and the promo noted. PocketGuard and YNAB pricing sourced directly from official pricing pages. Copilot Money pricing sourced from official site. Goodbudget pricing sourced from signup page. EveryDollar pricing sourced from ramseysolutions.com (official redirect). accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources. HIPAA/BAA: none of these consumer personal-finance apps publish HIPAA compliance or BAA offerings; all set null.

vendors.name: YNAB
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page ynab.com/pricing — page rendered full pricing content directly. Monthly $14.99, annual $109/yr. Corroborated by NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026).

plans.name: Monthly
plans.notes: Billed month-to-month at $14.99/mo. 34-day free trial, no credit card required. College students get 365-day free trial with proof of enrollment.

plans.name: Annual
plans.notes: Billed annually at $109/yr ($9.08/mo equivalent). Saves $70/yr vs monthly plan. Same features as monthly plan. 34-day free trial available.

vendors.name: Monarch Money
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page monarch.com/pricing renders via JavaScript and returned only partial content. Core plan pricing confirmed via NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026, $99.99/yr or $14.99/mo) and wellkeptwallet.com review (April 2026, $99.99/yr = $8.33/mo). Plus tier price ($199/yr, annual only) confirmed via the official Monarch announcement blog (monarch.com/blog/monarch-plus) and corroborated by multiple 2026 comparison sources. 7-day free trial and money-back guarantee confirmed on official site.

plans.name: Core (Monthly)
plans.notes: Month-to-month billing at $14.99/mo. 7-day free trial. New users can get 30% off first year with code WELCOME on annual Core plan.

plans.name: Core (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $99.99/yr ($8.33/mo equivalent). 7-day free trial, money-back guarantee. 30% off first year promo available (code WELCOME, web checkout, new users only).

plans.name: Plus (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $199/yr ($16.58/mo equivalent); annual billing only, no month-to-month option. Adds power-user features: Forecasting, Morningstar investment analysis, small-business tracking, and RSU tracking. Existing Monarch members get $50 off the first year. 7-day free trial. Price confirmed from the official Monarch Plus announcement page.

vendors.name: Copilot Money
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page copilot.money/pricing — rendered full pricing content directly. Single paid tier: $7.92/mo or $95/yr. Corroborated by NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026, $13/mo or $95/yr — NerdWallet's $13/mo may be rounded or reflect a different billing period; official site $7.92/mo is recorded).

plans.name: Copilot (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $95/yr ($7.92/mo equivalent). No ads, no hidden fees. Free test-drive available before connecting accounts; full free trial also offered. iOS/macOS only.

vendors.name: PocketGuard
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page pocketguard.com/pricing — rendered full pricing content directly. Monthly $12.99, annual $74.99/yr. Corroborated by NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026).

plans.name: Plus (Monthly)
plans.notes: Month-to-month billing. 7-day free trial. Includes unlimited bank accounts (US and Canada), unlimited category budgets, rollover budgeting, recurring bill tracking, subscription management, priority human support and AI chat.

plans.name: Plus (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $74.99/yr ($6.25/mo equivalent). Saves $81/yr vs monthly plan. 7-day free trial. Lifetime option available for select customers (one-time payment; price not published on pricing page).

vendors.name: Rocket Money
vendors.provenance: Rocket Money Premium uses a 'pay what you think is fair' model. The official pricing explainer (rocketmoney.com/learn/personal-finance/how-much-does-rocket-money-cost) states the range is typically $7–$14/mo with a $7/mo minimum, corroborated by 2026 reviews (CNBC Select, Penny Hoarder). The minimum confirmable self-serve price ($7/mo) is recorded as monthlyUsd. An earlier $3/mo minimum could not be confirmed against any current credible source and was corrected. Free tier existence confirmed by official homepage; 7-day Premium free trial confirmed by official page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier includes account linking, balance alerts, subscription management, and spend tracking. Bill negotiation incurs a 40% success fee on annual savings negotiated.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Pay-what-you-want pricing model; official page states the range is typically $7–$14/mo with a $7/mo minimum. monthlyUsd records the $7/mo confirmable minimum. Adds subscription cancellation assistant, automated savings, unlimited budgets, net worth tracking, shared accounts. 7-day free trial. Bill negotiation success fee (reported 35%–60% of first-year savings) applies when Rocket Money negotiates a lower bill.

vendors.name: Quicken Simplifi
vendors.provenance: Official Quicken pricing comparison page quicken.com/products/pricing-comparison — rendered full pricing content. Regular annual rate: $5.99/mo billed annually ($71.88/yr). Promotional first-year rate: $2.99/mo (offer valid through July 12, 2026 for new members ordering directly). Corroborated by official product page quicken.com/products/simplifi/.

plans.name: Simplifi (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $71.88/yr ($5.99/mo). No month-to-month option published. Promotional first-year rate of $2.99/mo available for new members through July 12, 2026, when ordering directly from Quicken. 30-day money-back guarantee. Auto-renews at then-current rate after first year.

vendors.name: Goodbudget
vendors.provenance: Goodbudget signup/pricing page goodbudget.com/signup — rendered full pricing content. Free tier: $0. Plus: $10/mo or $80/yr. Corroborated by NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026, $10/mo or $80/yr).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Envelope budgeting app. Free tier includes 10 regular envelopes, 10 additional envelopes, 1 account, 2 devices, 1 year of transaction history, debt tracking, and community support. No bank sync on free tier.

plans.name: Plus (Monthly)
plans.notes: Month-to-month billing at $10/mo. Includes automatic bank sync (US banks only), unlimited envelopes, unlimited accounts, 5 devices, 7 years of history, email support.

plans.name: Plus (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $80/yr ($6.67/mo equivalent). Same features as monthly Plus. Saves $40/yr vs monthly plan.

vendors.name: EveryDollar
vendors.provenance: everydollar.com redirects to ramseysolutions.com/money/everydollar which rendered full pricing content. Free tier: $0. Premium: $17.99/mo or $79.99/yr ($6.67/mo). Corroborated by NerdWallet best-budget-apps article (2026, $17.99/mo or $79.99/yr).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Zero-based budgeting app (Dave Ramsey method). Free tier: manual transaction entry only, custom categories, bill tracking, sinking funds. No automatic bank connections.

plans.name: Premium (Monthly)
plans.notes: Month-to-month billing at $17.99/mo. Adds automatic bank connections, personalized savings recommendations, debt tracking, expert coaching sessions, financial goal planning. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Premium (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $79.99/yr ($6.67/mo equivalent). Same features as monthly Premium. Saves $135.89/yr vs monthly plan. 14-day free trial.
